scenario.s1: The Cellar of the Plump Goose
scenario.s1.intro: Mistress Marta sighs: "Someone in the Plump Goose is carrying off everything that shines. Go down to the cellar and put things right. Mind the barrels!"
scenario.s1.outro: Among the stolen spoons and bowls lay a shard of the Lantern, dim but warm. Mistress Marta wraps it carefully in a cloth: "This is only the beginning."
scenario.s2.goal: All living heroes must reach the exit hexes by the forester's lodge
scenario.s2.intro: Mistress Marta unrolls a map: "The forester saw a light in the old lodge. The path there is overgrown with thorns, and the wolves have gone quite wild this autumn. Make your way to the hut and see who is lighting it."
scenario.s2.outro: By the lodge there was only the ash of a campfire and the prints of bandit boots. The tracks lead down to the old mill on the river.
scenario.s3.intro: The river has burst its banks and the mill stands knee-deep in water. Bandits guard the yard, and in the millpond under the wheel something big and wet is muttering. They say there is a lever in the sluice that drains the water.
scenario.s3.outro: The slime slides off the Miller and he is himself again: a tired old man who barely remembers the last few weeks. "Shadowhand," he whispers. "Tall, in a cloak of shadow. He took the light up to the old tower."
scenario.s4.goal: Take the Lantern piece from the upper tier and bring it back to the entrance
scenario.s4.intro: Lights burn again on the tower above the pass, but their glow is cold. The Gloom cultists have hidden the second piece of the Lantern there. The door to the upper tier is locked, and one of them carries the key.
scenario.s4.outro: The second piece of the Lantern is warm as bread from the oven. Among the cultists' papers lies a key of black glass: the key to the Heart of Gloom.
scenario.s5.intro: Beneath the Grey Mountains, behind a door of black glass, Shadowhand keeps the stolen light. Cold braziers stand along the walls. Light them, and the shadow will have nowhere to hide.
scenario.s5.outro: The glass orb on Shadowhand's chest cracks and the light comes home. Above Alba the Guardian Lantern shines again. Mistress Marta pours everyone hot tea: "Well, Braves, get some rest. Tomorrow brings new work."
scenarioSpecial.millSluice: A hero next to the sluice lever may spend a top action to lower the sluice: the water in the millpond gets shallow and the Miller's "Flood" no longer works
scenarioSpecial.runeShield: Cultists on rune hexes get Shield 1
scenarioSpecial.carriedItemDrops: One hero carries the Lantern piece; if they are exhausted, it drops on their hex
scenarioSpecial.braziers: A hero next to a cold brazier may spend a bottom action to light it. While fewer than 3 braziers burn, Shadowhand takes half damage. A wraith that ends its turn next to a brazier puts it out

event.s1.barrel: The barrel cracks open and rats leap out!
event.s2.howl: The pack leader howls, and the pack answers from the ravine!
event.s2.howl-stopped: The leader falls silent. The pack will not come.
event.s3.wave: The sluice gurgles, and new slimes crawl out of the channel!
event.s4.alarm: The cultist throws open the door upstairs and calls the guard!
event.s4.alarm-stopped: The cultist is caught: no alarm. He dropped a few coins.
event.s5.wave: New shades crawl out of the tunnel!
special.hammerQuake: Hammer Quake: {damage} damage to every hero within {radius}, cracks on {cracks} hexes
scenarioSpecial.caveIns: Cave-ins: a crack marks a hex one round ahead, then rocks fall and the hex becomes rubble
scenarioSpecial.windGusts: Wind gusts: at the end of every even round, all figures on the ledge are pushed 1 hex the way the pennants flap. Rams are not moved
scenarioSpecial.prisoners: Prisoners: break the locks of all cages. Freed miners flee the board
scenarioSpecial.darkness: Darkness: a figure on a dark hex can only be attacked from range 2 or closer. The lantern and lit braziers light a radius of 2
scenarioSpecial.darkLanternShield: While the Dark Lantern on the anvil is whole, Hammerfist has Shield 3. The furnaces call night moths every round
scenarioSpecial.mirrorHexes: Mirror hexes: a ranged attack on a figure standing on a mirror has disadvantage; an area attack breaks the mirror
scenarioSpecial.automatonHelpers: Automaton helpers: the storeroom has two wind-up levers; whoever turns one winds up a brass automaton
scenarioSpecial.livingBooks: Living books: the shelves whisper; walking past them may wake the books, and they call a ghost
scenarioSpecial.beamMirrors: Beam: turn a mirror with a top action next to it; when all three mirrors shine, the beam opens the way out
scenarioSpecial.allyPhase: Friend in the second phase: at half health the Guardian stops being an enemy, and its heart must be kept safe for 3 rounds
scenario.s6.goal: Get every hero onto the lift by the end of round 11
scenario.s6.intro: The miners of Copperdale went into the mine three days ago and never came back. The tunnel is the shortest way, but the ceiling is old: where it cracks, rocks will soon fall. Run for the lift.
scenario.s6.outro: The gallery collapsed behind you, and in the chest lay Theo's helmet with one word on it: "Forge". A path leads down to Copperdale.
scenario.s7.goal: Lead the shepherd to the outpost gate
scenario.s7.intro: The long path over the pass leads to Copperdale. A shepherd is heading there too, and on the ledge the wind knocks even goats off their feet. Stay near the shepherd: he won't go on without you.
scenario.s7.outro: The shepherd arrived safe and gave you a sack of warm wool. From the outpost you can see Copperdale and the cultists' purple lanterns.
scenario.s8.goal: Break open all 3 cages of miners
scenario.s8.intro: Cultists and bandits have locked the miners in cages. Theo must be in the office, and a cultist in the south storeroom carries its key.
scenario.s8.outro: The miners are free, and Theo hugs Lina. He told you about the Old Forge and Hammerfist and left his lantern at the entrance to the depths.
scenario.s9.goal: Carry the miner's lamp to the seal on the gate
scenario.s9.intro: Under the mountains it's dark as a sack. Carry Theo's lantern to the forge gate: whoever falls will drop it. The moths fly to the light.
scenario.s9.outro: The seal blazed up, and the gate swung open. From inside come the boom of a hammer and the giant's sleepy voice.
scenario.s10.intro: Hammerfist, the old smith giant, forges the Dark Lantern by night. While the Lantern on the anvil is whole, the giant is almost impossible to hurt, and the furnaces call the moths. Wake him up.
scenario.s10.outro: The Dark Lantern shattered, the moths turned white, and the giant woke up and said sorry for the noise. Only one black moth flew off to the north.
scenario.s11.goal: All heroes reach the ferryman’s farm by the end of round 13
scenario.s11.intro: The black moths flew south, into the Sleepy Marsh. A narrow boardwalk leads through the mist to the ferryman’s farm, and the Hopper Chief leaps along beside it. Whoever gets there first gets the ferry.
scenario.s11.outro: The party got there first. The ferryman says someone weaves the mist on old looms, and Old Heron and the fireflies are in trouble.
event.s11.frog-choir: Frog choir! New frogs leap out of the water by the footbridge.
event.s11.ferry-bell: Ding! The ferryman heard the bell and is poling the ferry over. The water by the farm is shallow now.
event.s11.rival-gone: The Hopper Chief is chased off. It dives into the reeds and quits the race.
event.s11.rival-home: The Hopper Chief is already at the farm, croaking from the roof. Hurry!
scenario.s12.goal: Lead Old Heron to the boat at the pier
scenario.s12.intro: The mist has crept up to the hut of Old Heron, the healer who taught the Herbalist. She can’t find her boat on her own. Lead her through the garden and the misty reeds to the pier.
scenario.s12.outro: Old Heron is in her boat. She remembered a boy called Lumo who got lost in the marsh when his little lantern went out, and promised to make a lantern that would never go out.
event.s12.ambush: Ambush in the reeds! Shadows step out of the mist.
event.s12.horn: The horn blower sounded his horn, and a big frog climbs out of the water!
event.s12.horn-stopped: The horn blower is chased off and the horn is silent. He dropped a few coins.
event.s12.herb: Old Heron picks a bunch of herbs and tucks it into her basket.
event.s12.map: In the chest lies an old bell-ringer’s map. It shows a bell tower in the middle of the marsh.
scenario.s13.goal: Break all 3 moth cocoons over the pond
scenario.s13.goal.defend: Hold out for 7 rounds so at least one firefly is left at the pond
scenario.s13.intro: Black cocoons hang over the forest pond, and the moths from them are putting out the fireflies one by one. Guard the paths and keep them from the water until morning comes.
scenario.s13.outro: The fireflies saw the morning and showed a memory: the boy Lumo caught them in a jar so he wouldn’t fear the night, and let them go each morning. The Guardian Lantern’s first lights were fireflies.
event.s13.firefly-out: A moth put out a firefly. {n} left.
event.s13.wave-east: Moths are flying in from the east!
event.s13.wave-west: Frogs are hopping in from the west!
event.s13.wave-north: A shadow drifts in along the north path!
event.s13.wave-all: Moths are coming down all three paths!
event.s13.wave-cultist: A cultist brings more moths. This is the last wave!
event.s13.cocoon: The cocoon cracks and crumbles into black dust.
event.s13.map: In the hollow tree sits an old chest with a bell-ringer’s map. It shows a bell tower in the middle of the marsh.
scenario.s14.goal: Ring the 3 bells in the map’s order and reach the roof by the end of round 12
scenario.s14.intro: The bell-ringer’s map leads to an old bell tower in the middle of the marsh. Ring the three bells in the right order and the hatch to the roof will open. But the water in the tower is rising.
scenario.s14.outro: The bells woke the marsh, and one of the Mist Queen’s looms broke. The bell-ringer’s chest held his little bell.
event.s14.bell-right: Ding! The bell rings clear. Just right.
event.s14.bell-wrong: Bo-o-ong! Wrong bell. A slime crawls out of the water, and you have to start again.
event.s14.hatch: All three bells sing together. The hatch to the roof is open!
event.s14.water-rises: The water is rising! The bottom row is flooded.
event.s14.water-deep: It’s deep down there now. Better not step in.
event.s14.treasure: The bell-ringer’s chest holds coins and a little bell.
scenario.s15.intro: At the heart of the marsh the Mist Queen weaves mist on old looms. While they stand she’s hard to reach, and each one calls more moths. Break the looms and set her free.
scenario.s15.outro: The Queen turned white and showed a memory: the Guardian Lantern was carried up to Alba’s town hall, and Lumo was left alone in the dark workshop. The black moths flew to the Shadow Tower, and the mist follows them towards the city.
event.s15.loom-moth: The loom clacks, and a moth flutters out of the cloth.
event.s15.loom-broken: The loom falls apart, and the mist around the Queen grows thinner.
event.s15.looms-down: All the looms are silent. Now the Queen can be seen clearly.
event.s15.bells: The bells from the tower have already broken one loom. Only two are left.
event.s15.last-thread: The last thread! Every loom still standing heals the Queen.
scenario.s16.goal: Escort Master Ida’s cart to the gate of Glass Town
scenario.s16.intro: The second flock of black moths flew east, to Glass Town. Ida, an old lamplighter, is taking her cart there along the crystal road. Get her safely to the town gate, and don’t break the mirrors by the roadside.
scenario.s16.outro: Ida has reached the gate. She told you Lumo was her best apprentice: his workshop still stands on the hill, and his notes are kept in the Library of Light.
event.s16.flash: Flash! The mirrors light up, and moths fly out of the farthest ones.
event.s16.lookout: The gremlin lookout is rocking the bridge. Now it’s hard going.
event.s16.lookout-gone: The lookout is chased off and the bridge holds still. He dropped a few coins.
event.s16.mirror-broken: Ding! A mirror cracked and went dark.
event.s16.crate: Ida opens a crate on her cart: “For your trouble.” There are coins inside.
scenario.s17.goal: Carry the Lantern drawing from the attic to the workshop door
scenario.s17.intro: Lumo’s workshop still stands on the hill above Glass Town. The Guardian Lantern drawing lies in the attic, and brass automatons sleep in the storeroom. Carry the drawing out to the door.
scenario.s17.outro: The party has the drawing. In its margin Lumo sketched the Glass Guardian, a helper automaton, so the workshop wouldn’t be lonely.
event.s17.blueprint-up: The drawing is lifted, and gremlins come running into the glassworks!
event.s17.automatons-wake: The brass automatons wake up and start ticking.
event.s17.lever: The winding key turns, and a helper automaton joins your side!
event.s17.dropped: The carrier is worn out and puts the drawing down on the floor.
event.s17.key: In the attic chest lies a crystal key with a mirror engraved on it.
scenario.s18.goal: Get all heroes to the reading room with Lumo’s diary
scenario.s18.intro: Lumo’s diary is kept in the Library of Light. The shelves there are alive: at night the books whisper, and anyone who makes a noise near them wakes the ghosts. Reach the reading room with the whole party.
scenario.s18.outro: The party has the diary. Lumo wrote about the evening the Guardian Lantern was taken to Alba: he gave the town all his lights and was left in the dark workshop himself.
event.s18.alarm: A book woke up and shrieked! A ghost flies out of the shelf, and the whole hall wakes up.
event.s18.quiet: Not a sound until round 5. Someone left a few coins on the windowsill.
event.s18.page: A page from Lumo’s diary falls out of the shelf.
event.s18.key: In the reading room chest lies a crystal key with a mirror engraved on it.
scenario.s19.goal: Turn the 3 mirrors so the beam opens the crystal door, then get out
scenario.s19.intro: The crystal key opens an old hall full of mirrors. Lumo built it to catch the sun from the window. Turn the three mirrors and the beam will open the crystal door. But dark mirrors call moths.
scenario.s19.outro: The beam reached the door. The mirrors showed how Lumo wanted to catch the light forever, but the sun set and he was left in the dark again. Deep under the mountain something chimed: the Glass Guardian’s shield has cracked.
event.s19.mirror-turn: The mirror turns, and the beam falls a new way.
event.s19.shard-moth: A dark mirror cracks, and a moth flies out!
event.s19.beam: All three mirrors face the right way! The beam has opened the crystal door.
event.s19.die: A crystal die rests on a cushion in the back room.
scenario.s20.goal: Free the Glass Guardian from the moth, then protect his heart for 3 rounds
scenario.s20.intro: Under Glass Town, in a crystal dome, stands the Glass Guardian, Lumo’s helper automaton. A black moth in his chest won’t let him wake. Break through his shield, then keep his crystal heart safe from the moths.
scenario.s20.outro: The Guardian woke up and showed a memory: the Guardian Lantern was taken to Alba, and Lumo walked out of the dark workshop into the night without a single light. The Guardian joins the party, while the black moths fly to the Shadow Tower and the mist follows them towards the city.
event.s20.no-shield: The Mirror Hall has already cracked the Guardian’s shield. He stands without it.
event.s20.ally: The moth has flown out of the Guardian’s chest! Now he is your friend. Protect his heart for 3 rounds.
event.s20.wave: Moths fly in through the dome windows, straight for the Guardian’s heart!
event.s20.heart-safe: The clock strikes for the third time. The moths give up, and the Guardian’s heart is safe.
event.s20.gift: The Guardian gives you the Glass Shield.
